text: The CalDAV provider uses locationPath for the remote resource and item.id for the ICS identity. Proposed manual naming guidance: state the role when an operation holds both storage location and logical identity. Preserve existing cache keys and wire values; no repository-wide id naming ban is established.
title: Use a role name for stored paths rather than call every identifier id
